hunks.baseline: “Yes. The Sichuan Tang Clan has even denied the existence of the Myriad-Poison Ring several times.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. The Sichuan Tang Clan has denied the existence of the Myriad-Poison Ring several times.”

hunks.baseline: The Divine Physician added in a heavy voice, “That is why it is a legend. It is so old that it has been passed down only through people’s mouths.”
hunks.sol: The Divine Physician added in a heavy voice, “That is why it is a legend. It is so ancient that it has survived only through word of mouth.”

hunks.baseline: After thinking for a moment, I suddenly opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: After thinking for a moment, I spoke up.

hunks.baseline: I naturally continued, “If such a sacred artifact existed, would people really leave it alone? The Sichuan Tang Clan is famous throughout the Murim for being stubbornly reclusive. Naturally, they would want to avoid any unnecessary trouble.”
hunks.sol: I smoothly continued, “If word got out that they possessed a sacred artifact like that, do you think people would leave them alone? The Sichuan Tang Clan is famous throughout the Murim for being stubbornly insular. Naturally, they would want to avoid the trouble.”

hunks.baseline: It was a hastily improvised explanation, but it was convincing enough that everyone nodded.
hunks.sol: It was a hastily improvised explanation, but convincing enough that everyone nodded.

hunks.baseline: I looked at Gung Gibang, who had opened his mouth as if he had been waiting for this moment.
hunks.sol: I looked at Gung Gibang, who had jumped in as though he had been waiting for the chance.

hunks.baseline: “I want to go with you too! Please, don’t leave this vicious beggar and me behind!”
hunks.sol: “I want to go with you too! Please don’t leave me here with this vicious beggar!”

hunks.baseline: “What? You worthless bastard!”
hunks.sol: “What?! You dog-bone bastard!”

hunks.baseline: Sometimes, a good beating was the best medicine. I shook my fists at the two men, who were clutching the tops of their heads.
hunks.sol: Sometimes, a good beating was the best medicine. I shook my fists at the two men as they clutched the tops of their heads.

hunks.baseline: “Stop talking nonsense and stay here to guard Venerable Myoryeong. If anything happens, Gung Gibang, you contact me immediately.”
hunks.sol: “Stop talking nonsense and stay here to guard Venerable Myoryeong. If anything happens, Gung Gibang, let us know immediately.”

hunks.baseline: “Contact you? Is there a messenger pigeon here that can fly to the Sichuan Tang Clan?”
hunks.sol: “Let you know? Is there a messenger pigeon here that can fly to the Sichuan Tang Clan?”

hunks.baseline: “What kind of beggar’s-foot-rag nonsense is that? If something happens, you need to come running after us so fast your feet catch fire.”
hunks.sol: “What kind of beggar’s-foot-rag nonsense is that? If something happens, you come running so fast your feet catch fire.”

hunks.baseline: “What do you mean?”
hunks.sol: “What the hell?”

hunks.baseline: “If you don’t like that, tame one. There were plenty of butterflies in the flower garden.”
hunks.sol: “If you don’t like it, tame one. I saw plenty of butterflies in the flower garden.”

hunks.baseline: It was a conclusion I had reached after a cold analysis, brief though it had been.
hunks.sol: It was a conclusion I had reached after a brief but coolheaded analysis.

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang was a reasonably capable Peak master, and his feet were as quick as his wits. He would be able to handle any unforeseen crisis.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang was a reasonably capable Peak master, and he was as quick on his feet as he was on the uptake. He should be able to handle any unforeseen crisis.

hunks.baseline: At that moment, one person’s arm shot into the air. Cheongpung asked with an innocent expression, “What about me, Benefactor?”
hunks.sol: At that moment, an arm shot into the air. Cheongpung asked with an innocent expression, “What about me, Benefactor?”

hunks.baseline: “Within a few days, he’ll burn this whole place down and leave Old Man Dong homeless—and I’ll bet Mujin’s left wrist the old man ends up joining the Beggars’ Sect.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll wager Mujin’s left wrist that within a few days he’ll burn down your whole cottage, leave you homeless, and drive you into joining the Beggars’ Sect.”

hunks.baseline: Mungyeong thought deeply for a moment, then nodded as if he had made his decision.
hunks.sol: Mungyeong thought it over for a moment, then nodded decisively.

hunks.baseline: “I will follow my Master as well. The Emei nun should have no trouble as long as she gets some rest.”
hunks.sol: “I will accompany you, Master. The Emei nun should have no trouble as long as she gets some rest.”

hunks.baseline: The person I needed most right now was actually the Divine Physician. But having Mungyeong with us would be even better. He was always at his Master’s side, serving as a capable assistant.
hunks.sol: The person I needed most right now was the Divine Physician. But having Mungyeong with us would be even better. He was always at his Master’s side, serving as a capable assistant.

hunks.baseline: Myriad-Poison Asura Tang Sadok. If I met him, the head of the Sichuan Tang Clan, I would know for certain.
hunks.sol: Myriad-Poison Asura Tang Sadok. The answer would become clear once I faced the head of the Sichuan Tang Clan.

hunks.baseline: Once I had finished thinking, I turned to Cheongpung.
hunks.sol: Having made up my mind, I turned to Cheongpung.

hunks.baseline: “We need to get there as fast as possible. It’d be a disaster if we dropped you along the way, so we’ll tie you both down tight with the ropes.”
hunks.sol: “We need to get there as fast as possible. It’d be a disaster if we dropped either of them along the way, so we’ll tie them down tight.”

hunks.baseline: “Some fifty years ago, before you were even born, our family suffered a great humiliation. Do you know about it?”
hunks.sol: “More than fifty years ago, before you were even born, our family suffered a great humiliation. Do you know about it?”

hunks.baseline: The great war that lasted ten long years ended with the orthodox faction’s victory. The Tang Clan returned to Sichuan and rebuilt its family, but the scars from that time had been carved deeply into everyone’s hearts.
hunks.sol: The Great Faction War raged for ten long years before ending in victory for the orthodox faction. The Tang Clan returned to Sichuan and rebuilt, but the scars from that time had been carved deep into everyone’s hearts.

hunks.baseline: “And yet—how? How could we suffer such humiliation again?”
hunks.sol: “And yet… And yet, how?”

hunks.baseline: The instant green light flashed in Tang Sadok’s eyes, the middle-aged man held his breath as poisonous energy poured from Tang Sadok’s entire body.
hunks.sol: Green light flashed in Tang Sadok’s eyes. As toxic energy poured from his entire body, the middle-aged man sucked in a breath.

hunks.baseline: “How dare they make us suffer this kind of humiliation again!”
hunks.sol: “How can we suffer such humiliation again?”

hunks.baseline: Not only the wood but even the iron fittings along the corners liquefied into black poison and flowed across the floor. The middle-aged man immediately prostrated himself.
hunks.sol: Not only the wood but even the iron fittings along its corners liquefied into black poison. The middle-aged man immediately prostrated himself.

hunks.baseline: Despite the middle-aged man’s pleas, Tang Sadok’s anger did not easily subside.
hunks.sol: Despite the middle-aged man’s plea, Tang Sadok’s anger did not easily subside.

hunks.baseline: His fury was only natural. Instead of finding the culprit who had harmed his father, Poison King Tang Taesang, he had returned after chasing false leads and receiving an urgent message from the Qingcheng Sect.
hunks.sol: His fury was only natural. Instead of finding the culprit who had harmed his father, Poison King Tang Taesang, he had come up empty and been forced to return after receiving an urgent message from the Qingcheng Sect.

hunks.baseline: And it had not been an assassination targeting a single person. It was said to have been a head-on fight.
hunks.sol: And it had not been a surprise attack targeting a single person. It was said to have been a head-on fight.

hunks.baseline: Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun was a Supreme Peak master who could have aimed for even the lowest position among the Ten Kings. The three Elders who had been with her were also experienced Peak masters.
hunks.sol: Heaven-Shaking Venerable Nun was a Supreme Peak master who could have vied for even the lowest seat among the Ten Kings. The three Elders with her were also seasoned Peak masters.

hunks.baseline: The killer had single-handedly brought down the leadership of an entire sect, then vanished like a ghost.
hunks.sol: The culprit had single-handedly brought down the leadership of an entire sect, then vanished like a ghost.

hunks.baseline: “They divided into ten groups of five and scattered from Chengdu toward Qingcheng, Emei, Yishan, and Sanhe to carry out their missions.”
hunks.sol: “They divided into ten groups of five and scattered from Chengdu toward Qingcheng, Emei, Yishan, Sanhe, and the surrounding areas to carry out their missions.”

hunks.baseline: Even within the Sichuan Tang Clan, the Green Shadow Squad were specialists in intelligence gathering and assassinating key targets.
hunks.sol: Even within the Sichuan Tang Clan, the Green Shadow Squad specialized in intelligence gathering and assassinating key targets.

hunks.baseline: They had been chiefly responsible for eliminating countless demon heads immediately after the Great Faction War, but Tang Sadok felt an inexplicable sense of foreboding.
hunks.sol: They had played the greatest role in eliminating countless fiends after the Great Faction War, yet Tang Sadok felt an inexplicable sense of foreboding.

hunks.baseline: As Tang Sadok watched the middle-aged man turn away cautiously, he suddenly spoke.
hunks.sol: Tang Sadok watched the middle-aged man turn away cautiously, then suddenly spoke.

hunks.baseline: “I’m saying this as your uncle, not as the Family Head. You’re nearly fifty. How long did you think I would leave my only nephew in the Gate Guard Pavilion?”
hunks.sol: “I’m saying this as your uncle, not as the Family Head. You’re nearly fifty. How long did you think I would leave my only nephew at the Gate Guard Pavilion?”

hunks.baseline: Tang Sadok answered by flicking his sleeve.
hunks.sol: Tang Sadok answered with a flick of his sleeve.

hunks.baseline: Tang Sadok had grown numb with time and lived for many years without thinking about it. Yet recently, he had begun remembering his elder brother, who had lost his life during the Great Faction War.
hunks.sol: Tang Sadok had grown numb with time and lived for many years without thinking about it. Only recently had he begun remembering his elder brother, who had lost his life during the Great Faction War.

hunks.baseline: At Tang Sadok’s quiet monologue, spoken after he was left alone, his chest rose and fell. Then something slowly poked its head out.
hunks.sol: At Tang Sadok’s quiet monologue, something stirred at his chest and slowly poked its head out.

hunks.baseline: It had a body as white as snow, blue eyes, and a triangular head with two horns. It was a snake.
hunks.sol: It had a body as white as snow, blue eyes, and a triangular head crowned with two horns. It was a snake.

hunks.baseline: A spiritual creature known throughout the Murim as the Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake, it was notorious for its ferocity. It stuck out its long tongue and licked Tang Sadok’s cheek.
hunks.sol: A spiritual creature known throughout the Murim as the Thousand-Year Poison Horned Snake, it was notorious for its ferocity. It flicked out its long tongue and licked Tang Sadok’s cheek.

hunks.baseline: He was watching the snake play with a faint smile when the sound of someone’s approaching footsteps grew closer.
hunks.sol: He was watching the snake’s antics with a faint smile when the sound of approaching footsteps grew louder.

hunks.baseline: The white body hurriedly slipped inside Tang Sadok’s robes.
hunks.sol: The white body hurriedly slipped back inside Tang Sadok’s robes.

hunks.baseline: At the voice of his nephew, who had left only moments earlier, Tang Sadok deliberately furrowed his brow.
hunks.sol: At the voice of his nephew, who had left only moments earlier, Tang Sadok affected a frown.

hunks.baseline: “I believe I explicitly ordered that no one be allowed inside. Denied.”
hunks.sol: “I explicitly ordered that no one be allowed inside. Refuse them entry.”

hunks.baseline: *Who was the Divine Physician? A man who had reached the realm of the divine through his medical arts. An unknown figure who had not shown himself for many long years.*
hunks.sol: *Who was the Divine Physician? A man said to have reached the divine realm through his medical arts. A mysterious figure who had not shown himself for many long years.*

hunks.baseline: His hesitation did not last long. A hoarse voice escaped between Tang Sadok’s lips.
hunks.sol: His hesitation did not last long. A hoarse voice escaped Tang Sadok’s lips.

hunks.baseline: Now that was some no-brakes macho-man talk.
hunks.sol: Now there was a macho man with no brakes.

hunks.baseline: Tang Sadok had asked the question out of nowhere without even pretending to look at us, and the Divine Physician let out a hearty laugh.
hunks.sol: Tang Sadok asked without so much as looking at us, and the Divine Physician let out a hearty laugh.

hunks.baseline: “Seems they were right.”
hunks.sol: “Seems you are, then.”

hunks.baseline: “Unless someone has a death wish, no one tells lies in front of this old man.”
hunks.sol: “Unless someone is desperate to die, no one tells lies in front of this old man.”

hunks.baseline: Tang Sadok slowly looked us over, his eyes filled with their usual green light.
hunks.sol: Tang Sadok slowly looked us over, a green glow shimmering in his eyes.

hunks.baseline: “The Divine Physician… You, whom the whole world has searched for without catching even a glimpse of you, have come looking for me. And you have brought young prodigies of the Murim with you. Why?”
hunks.sol: “The Divine Physician… You vanished without a trace while the whole world searched for you, yet now you have come looking for me. And with young prodigies of the Murim, no less. Why?”

hunks.baseline: At my no-brakes macho-man approach, Tang Sadok’s pupils trembled.
hunks.sol: At my own macho-man-with-no-brakes delivery, Tang Sadok’s pupils trembled.
